dimensions.assessment: Affects SBA administrators, development companies, and small businesses participating in the 504 loan program.
dimensions.evidence: Administrator shall annually conduct a risk analysis of the portfolio of the Administration with respect to all loans guaranteed under this title.

dimensions.assessment: Administrative risk oversight, reporting, and enforcement metrics tracking for the 504 loan portfolio.
dimensions.evidence: submit to Congress a report containing the results of each portfolio risk analysis... which shall include an analysis of the overall program risk

dimensions.assessment: No new funding authorized, though it mandates tracking loan defaults, recoveries, charge-offs, and civil monetary penalties.

dimensions.assessment: Amends Title V of the Small Business Investment Act of 1958 to add a statutory risk analysis and reporting requirement.

importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Small Business Administration to conduct an annual portfolio risk analysis of all loans guaranteed under the 504 loan program and report the findings and mitigation steps to Congress.
